NameMultiLanguage.zh: 危机合约-遗落都市-高危-day38

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All zombies except Imp Gargantuars gain +100% health and attack damage, +120% armor durability, and -25% dynamic point requirement
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 除巨人投掷的小鬼外所有僵尸的生命值和攻击力+100%，防具耐久度+120%，动态点数需求-25%

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Lost Pilot Veterans gain +50% attack damage, with landing timing and carried enemies varying between waves
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有精英空降兵的攻击力+50%，不同波次落地的时间和携带敌人有所不同

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Relic Hunter gain +20% movement speed, and land one tile forward
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有遗迹猎人的移动速度+20%，落地位置前移一格

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Crystal Skull gain +30% movement speed and +30% health, have increased attack range and charge cooldown, and fire immediately after absorbing sun
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有考古学家的移动速度和生命值+30%，攻击距离和蓄力冷却时间变长，吸收阳光后立刻发射

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Some waves and dynamic spawning are modified
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 部分波次和动态出怪有所不同
